newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA CRISIL ASSIGNS RATES ASIAN BONDS.
newsitem.headline: INDIA CRISIL ASSIGNS RATES ASIAN BONDS.

text.p: The Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) said on Wednesday it assigned a 'AAA' (triple A) rating for the 600 million rupee non-convertible debenture issue of Asian Paints (India) Ltd.
This indicates the highest degree of safety regarding timely payment of interest and principal, it said.
It also retained a "P1" rating for the 300 million rupee commercial paper programme of the company.
"These ratings indicate Asian Paints' strong market position in the decorative paints segment arising out of an extensive distribution network and wide product base," it said.
